UNSAFE_className.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom class names for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

UNSAFE_style.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom style for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

container.description: Element where the SideDrawer portal should be rendered.

inline.description: Changes whether the SideDrawer is positioned to the side of the viewport or inline with the content.

onRequestClose.description: Callback function to close the drawer.

open.description: Whether or not the drawer is open.

scrollDirection.description: Change the scrolling direction of the drawer. Useful for chat-like interfaces.

variation.description: Change the appearance of the drawer.
